title: Update protocol and package documentation to reflect actual codebase (109 protocols, 12 packages)
body:
Documentation claimed 70 protocols; actual count is 109 across 12 categories (55% undercount). Updated all reference pages with accurate inventory.

## Changes

### Protocol Reference Updates
- **index.mdx**: Updated totals and expanded category listings
  - Data: 8 → 16 protocols (+100%)
  - System: 14 → 39 protocols (+179%)
  - API: 6 → 13 protocols (+117%)
  - Added Integration category (5 protocols)
- **protocol-map.mdx**: Updated architecture diagram layer counts
- **quick-reference.mdx**: Added comprehensive protocol tables for all categories
- **README.md**: Updated protocol count reference

### New Documentation
- **packages.mdx**: Complete package reference covering all 12 packages
  - Core packages (9): spec, core, runtime, objectql, client, client-react, cli, ai-bridge, types
  - Plugins (3): driver-memory, plugin-hono-server, plugin-msw
  - Includes dependency graph, installation guide, version matrix

### Navigation
- **meta.json**: Added packages, hub, integration, auth, shared pages to references navigation

## Protocol Distribution

| Category | Before | After |
|----------|--------|-------|
| Data | 8 | 16 |
| System | 14 | 39 |
| API | 6 | 13 |
| Integration | - | 5 |
| Others | 42 | 36 |
| **Total** | **70** | **109** |

Build verified: 207 pages generated successfully.
